summary.name: Libervia (Salut à Toi)
summary.one_liner: The page is an Anubis bot-check interstitial, not the project page; the only project information available comes from the awesome-selfhosted listing describing Libervia (Salut à Toi) as a multipurpose, multi-frontend, libre, decentralized communication tool.
summary.what_it_does: The fetched page is only an Anubis proof-of-work bot-check screen, so it shows no features of the project itself. Anubis is described as a Hashcash-style proof-of-work gate that slows AI scrapers, and it requires modern JavaScript, so plugins like JShelter must be disabled for the domain. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes Salut à Toi as a multipurpose, multi-frontend, libre and decentralized communication tool, licensed AGPL-3.0 and written in Python, and it is filed under XMPP web clients. No further capabilities could be verified from this page.
notable: Licensed AGPL-3.0 and written in Python (per listing)
Listed under XMPP web clients on awesome-selfhosted
caveats: The fetched page is a bot-check interstitial; project features could not be verified from it
Requires JavaScript; privacy plugins such as JShelter must be disabled for this domain to load the page
